Forge_description1: Place weapon or tool in the left slot. Place gemstone in the right slot.

می‌توانی دو حلقه را هم با هم ترکیب کنی.

Forge_unforge_right_slot: Empty out the right slot to unforge...

Forge_unforge_invalid: Only forged items and combined rings can be unforged...
